title: Southern Coastal | 4BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Southern Coastal is a pet-friendly 4BR Seacrest Beach cottage featuring a wraparound porch and resort pool access. This 30A rental sleeps 9 by Royal Destinations.
description_expanded: Description: Southern Coastal by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Resort Address: 192 E Seacrest Beach Boulevard Details: Southern charm meets coastal cool in Seacrest Beach. Perfectly situated between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, Southern Coastal is a beautifully appointed Florida cottage that puts you in the heart of everything 30A has to offer. Enjoy classic Southern-style living with a welcoming wraparound porch, ideal for relaxing with a cool drink under the fans. Inside, soaring 10-foot ceilings, wide pine floors, and an open-concept living space create a bright, inviting atmosphere. The chef’s kitchen features a gas cooktop, granite island, and stainless appliances — perfect for gatherings with family and friends. With four bedrooms, including two master suites (each with private balcony access), there’s room for everyone to unwind in comfort. Outside, you’ll find space for dining, lounging, and easy access to the 12,000-square foot resort pool and deeded beach access plus a seasonal tram to the Gulf’s emerald waters. This Seacrest gem is the perfect blend of charm, comfort, and 30A style. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.4 Miles (8-Minute Walk or 3-Minute Bike Ride) -Parking Spaces: 3 -Outdoor Shower -Dining Accommodations: 6 Dining Table, 4 Kitchen Island -Pet Friendly* *Additional Fee Applicable $300 each (pre-tax) *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. Seacrest Community Highlights: -Resort Lagoon Style Pool -Beach Shuttle (Runs March through October) -Deeded Community Beach Access Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 9 4 Bedrooms / 3.5 Baths First Floor: -Guest Room 1: King Bed with Private Bath, Balcony -Kitchen / Living / Dining -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Guest Room 2: King Bed with Private Bath, Balcony -Guest Room 3: Queen Bed with Shared Bath -Guest Room 4: Bunk Room (Twin/Full) with Shared Bath Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Beach Towel Service Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
